$comment: Marble.com is a countertop fabricator (NJ/NY/PA/CT showrooms) on its own PHP site (pjax, Bootstrap). Product pages are material pages, /<material>-countertops/<slug>/<id> (for example /granite-countertops/gran-perla/1179), from sitemap_materials.xml; /<material>-countertops alone is a listing. There is no price, cart or stock text (countertops are quoted per project), so the price is null with state unknown and a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. The material facts (Original Name, Material Type, Country of origin, Colors) are <strong> labels followed by bare text in one accordion card, which the specs reader cannot pair (it reads element values only), and the applications list (Kitchen Countertop, Bathroom Vanity Top, ...) has no selector field, so fetch.engine is default (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance): the LLM returns those as 4 specs and the applications as features, each checked against the page. The selectors below are the fallback for the http engine and the saved fixture: title is h1.material-name-title, image is the first full-screen gallery image (1280x720), description joins the Material_Desc paragraphs. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title, image and description, no specs; browser: the same, slower; duckduckgo, mojeek, yandex: SEARCH_PROVIDER_BLOCKED; yahoo: SEARCH_PROVIDER_ERROR; brave: not tried, no key; ai-crawler-avalai: SUCCESS with the same fields plus 4 specs and 15 features at 8,958+976 tokens; ai-crawler-cloudflare: not configured. ai-crawler-avalai is selected because it returns more data (specs and features the selectors cannot reach); switch to http (drop fetch) to save the tokens if specs are not needed. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key on the instance. Checked against saved (curl) Gran Perla and White Spring granite pages on 2026-11-19.
